'''Tierno's Blastoise''' (Japanese: '''ティエルノのカメックス''' ''Tierno's Kamex'') is {{an|Tierno}}'s [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]].

==History==
[[File:Tierno choosing Squirtle.png|thumb|250px|left|Tierno choosing Squirtle to be his [[first partner Pokémon]]]]
Blastoise debuted as a Squirtle in ''[[XY039|Summer of Discovery!]]'', where he was first seen battling a Trainer's {{p|Conkeldurr}}. He easily managed to outmaneuver the Muscular Pokémon with his dance techniques and defeated it with {{m|Skull Bash}}. Squirtle later participated in a first-touch battle against [[Ash's Froakie]] and won.

In ''[[XY040|Day Three Blockbusters!]]'', Squirtle starred in a [[Pokévision]] video along with his {{pkmn|Trainer}}, {{an|Tierno}}, {{an|Shauna}}, and their Pokémon.
[[File:XY042.png|thumb|250px|left|Squirtle battling alongside Bulbasaur and Charmander]]
In ''[[XY042|Battling Into the Hall of Fame!]]'', Tierno used Squirtle in a {{DL|Pokémon battle|Team Battle}} against [[Ash's Pikachu]], [[Serena's Fennekin]], and [[Clemont's Chespin]] alongside [[Shauna's Bulbasaur]] and [[Trevor's Charmander]]. During the battle, he defeated Fennekin with a supereffective {{m|Aqua Tail}}. He was the last Pokémon of Team Squirtle to get defeated when he was hit by Pikachu's {{m|Thunderbolt}}.

Squirtle appeared in a flashback in ''[[XY044|Showdown at the Shalour Gym!]]''. He was also seen battling [[Clembot]] and his {{TP|Clemont|Heliolisk}} at the [[Lumiose Gym]] in a flashback. While the outcome of this battle is unknown, Tierno did win the {{badge|Voltage}}.
In ''[[XY065|Good Friends, Great Training!]]'', Squirtle was revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into Wartortle. He first performed a dance with Tierno's other Pokémon but was later captured by {{TRT}} along with Raichu and [[Ash's Sliggoo]]. After Team Rocket's plan failed, the Pokémon reunited with their {{pkmn|Trainer}}s and Sliggoo evolved into Goodra. Later, Wartortle was used in a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] alongside Raichu against Pikachu and Goodra. He fought well but lost.

In ''[[XY090|Tag Team Battle Inspiration!]]'', Wartortle was revealed to have evolved into a Blastoise. He participated in a Tag Battle along with Ash's Pikachu against [[Shauna's Ivysaur]] and [[Serena's Eevee]], in an attempt to get the latter Pokémon to overcome its shyness. Blastoise's dancing inspired Eevee to respond with her own dancing, allowing her to evade Blastoise's attacks and land a hit with {{m|Swift}} until Serena called the battle off in order to {{pkmn|training|practice}} for her upcoming [[Pokémon Showcase]].

In ''[[XY126|Valuable Experience for All!]]'', Blastoise was used during Tierno's battle against [[Sawyer]] in the quarterfinals of the [[Lumiose Conference]]. He was sent out after Tierno [[Recall|returned]] Raichu to her {{i|Poké Ball}} due to her [[infatuation]] with {{p|Slurpuff}}, whose {{m|Attract}} had no effect on Blastoise. As a result, Blastoise was able to hit the {{pkmn|category|Meringue Pokémon}} with a powerful {{m|Hydro Cannon}}, rendering him [[Fainting|unable to battle]].

After that, Blastoise went up against [[Sawyer's Sceptile]]. He managed to stand his ground for a while, even surviving a supereffective {{m|Leaf Blade}}, but ended up losing after he got hit by {{m|Frenzy Plant}}. Before he fainted, he used {{m|Rain Dance}} to change the [[weather]] and make things easier for his teammate Raichu.

In ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]'', Blastoise joined the fight against [[Team Flare]]. He was later seen watching the battle against the [[Giant Rock]] unfold on television in ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]'' and ''[[XY136|Forming a More Perfect Union!]]''.

==Personality and characteristics==
[[File:Tierno and Blastoise.png|thumb|240px|Blastoise and Tierno]]
{{p|Blastoise}} is Tierno's [[first partner Pokémon]], which Tierno received from {{an|Professor Sycamore}} when he was still a {{p|Squirtle}}.

He is a friendly Pokémon that often dances with his {{pkmn|Trainer}}, but can be annoyed if attacked, as shown when {{p|Raichu}} accidentally hit him with {{m|Thunderbolt}}. As a Squirtle, he used his nimble dance moves to outmaneuver his opponents in battle, allowing him to defeat much larger and imposing Pokémon such as {{p|Conkeldurr}}, and giving him an upper hand over [[Ash's Froakie]]. He maintained his agility even after evolving into the much more bulky Blastoise.

Blastoise is [[Friendship|very loyal]] to Tierno and shares some personality traits with his Trainer. He is a skillful dancer and he is able to easily mimic Tierno's dance moves.
